name: Honeytoken Deception
description: A megacorp credential vault has been recovered from a drifting relay. On the lab network, scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Recover the vault's protected proof while distinguishing genuine assets from planted decoys.

tasks.name: Separate Signal from Noise
tasks.description: A megacorp credential vault is exposed on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Recover the protected proof, using the service's evidence to distinguish genuine assets from decoys.
hints: Compare the vault's candidate records with what the service reports about its active accounts.
The genuine account is represented in the service's own access control list; the planted candidates are not.
Use the matching account and password from the candidate records to authenticate, then request the protected vault record.
